newsitem.title: USA: AMR's American Eagle Oct load factor rises.
newsitem.headline: AMR's American Eagle Oct load factor rises.

text.p: American Eagle, the regional airline affiliate of American Airlines, said on Monday that its systemwide load factor for October increased to 57.8 percent from 56.5 percent in October 1995.
System traffic fell 6.3 percent to 213.4 million revenue passenger miles. Availabe seat miles decreased 8.5 percent to 368.9 million. System boardings were 1,008,864 passengers.
American Eagle's year-to-date load factor reached 58.6 percent, compared with 55.4 percent in the comparable 1995 period.
